dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: *cough* To tell the truth, I made a wish to the fountain fairy when the dragon attacked, wishing that it would keep Mondstadt safe.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Now, both the storm and the danger has passed. Does that mean that the fountain fairy truly exists?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I wish that the fairy can make me well soon — that would lessen my family's burden a little... *cough*
